description: Source code for the TableEntry class and related functions in the Android lshal namespace, handling table entries for hardware service listings including formatting, comparison, and string representation.

classes.name: TableEntry
classes.description: Represents a hardware service table entry with methods for retrieving fields, comparison, and string conversion.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Represents a collection of TableEntry objects with methods to create formatted text tables.

classes.name: MergedTable
classes.description: Represents a collection of multiple tables for combined display.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a specified field in the table entry.

methods.name: isReleased
methods.description: Indicates whether the hash signifies a released or unreleased state.

methods.name: getVintfInfo
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing VINTF info flags.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts a ServiceStatus enum to its string representation.

methods.name: createTextTable
methods.description: Generates a formatted text table of entries.
